english.note: Use this when resorting to a person, resource, or method to get through a difficult situation.

examples.english: The project nearly collapsed, so we had to turn to the boss for a loan.
examples.traditional: 今次工程差啲爛尾，我哋唯有靠老闆借錢頂住。
